length_limits.notes: Research Reports are preferred at 6 pages, about 4,000 words with about 50 references and 4 medium graphical elements, and capped at 12. Brief Reports are 3 pages, about 1,600 words and up to 15 references. The significance statement is up to 120 words.

figure_spec.notes: Size classes: small about 9x6 cm, medium about 11x11 cm, large about 18x22 cm. Raster at 300 ppi without text, 600-900 with text, 1,000-1,200 for line art. 3D figures as PRC or U3D.

reference_style.style: Numbered in order of first citation, following the CSE Manual (8th edition); more than five authors are listed as the first author and 'et al.'; the LaTeX bibliography style is pnas-new.bst.

submission_steps: submit through PNAS's own tracking system at https://www.pnascentral.org/cgi-bin/main.plex; no email submissions
the journal is format-neutral at initial submission
supply a data-sharing plan and funding information
suggest at least three reviewers, Editorial Board members or NAS members

template.notes: Word templates for the research article, Brief Report and SI Appendix, and LaTeX templates with a class, style and bibliography file plus Overleaf versions, all reachable without a login from the author centre; the URL is the main-manuscript Word file. Linked, never stored.
